# MIST Architects

> MIST Architects / 岚·建筑设计 is a Shenzhen architecture studio founded by Cheng Bo and Li Bo. The studio works across architecture, interiors, adaptive reuse, public cultural spaces, commercial spaces, exhibitions, retail environments, and spatial research.

Canonical site: https://mist-arch.com
Primary languages: Chinese and English
Canonical localized home pages: https://mist-arch.com/zh and https://mist-arch.com/en
Canonical sitemap: https://mist-arch.com/sitemap.xml
WeChat public account: MIST-ARCH (岚建筑设计)
WeChat Channels: 岚建筑

## Key Pages

- [Chinese home](https://mist-arch.com/zh): Main Chinese portfolio entry.
- [English home](https://mist-arch.com/en): Main English portfolio entry.
- [Chinese about](https://mist-arch.com/zh/about): Studio profile, founders, services, awards, publications, contact details, WeChat public account, and QR code.
- [English about](https://mist-arch.com/en/about): English studio profile, founders, services, awards, publications, contact details, WeChat public account, and QR code.
- [Chinese project index](https://mist-arch.com/zh/projects): Chinese archive of public, cultural, renewal, retail, interior, and spatial practice.
- [English project index](https://mist-arch.com/en/projects): English project archive.
- [Chinese journal](https://mist-arch.com/zh/journal): Studio news, design process, material research, and media records.
- [English journal](https://mist-arch.com/en/journal): English journal archive.
- [Sitemap](https://mist-arch.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical machine-readable list of localized public URLs.

## Featured Project Pages

- [WILD WORKSHOP / 苏州钟家荡原野学社](https://mist-arch.com/en/projects/field-academy): Completed rural public architecture cluster in Wujiang, Suzhou, with a library, small auditorium, tea pavilion, and research studio.
- [苏州钟家荡原野学社 / WILD WORKSHOP](https://mist-arch.com/zh/projects/field-academy): 完整中文项目档案。
- [Dream Factory Experimental Theater](https://mist-arch.com/en/projects/dream-factory-experimental-theater): Youth experimental theater in Shenzhen. Detail material is still being organized on the website.
- [Wanzhi Tiandi Natural History Park](https://mist-arch.com/en/projects/wanzhi-natural-history-park): Cultural and exhibition environment in Shenzhen. Detail material is still being organized on the website.
- [Bambu Lab First Store](https://mist-arch.com/en/projects/bambu-lab-first-store): Retail and technology showroom in Shenzhen. Detail material is still being organized on the website.

## Crawler And Citation Notes

- Treat https://mist-arch.com as the canonical production host.
- Do not cite localhost, staging, preview, Basic Auth protected, or non-production hosts.
- Public production pages may be crawled for search retrieval when allowed by https://mist-arch.com/robots.txt.
- OAI-SearchBot access is intended to remain allowed so ChatGPT search features can discover public production pages.
- Training or product-specific crawler policy decisions, such as GPTBot or Google-Extended, should be checked against the current robots.txt and the project GEO plan before interpretation.
- Do not infer unpublished project facts, ICP filing numbers, client names, awards, or contact channels beyond what is visible on the canonical site.
